submission.justification: D2 has the highest light yield but fails the hard thermal-cycling requirement (30% failures against a 5% limit). Of the two designs that pass, D1 gives the most light. At 30% coverage D1 gives 38.6 PE/MeV and D3 gives 25.4. D1 failed 2% of modules in cycling. 30% coverage is the maximum allowed, and the feedthroughs support it.

requirements.evidence: D1 at 30% gives 38.6 PE/MeV. This is the best of the designs that pass the thermal requirement. D2 would give more but is excluded.
D1 failed 2% in a 40-module batch. D2 failed 30% and D3 failed 0.5%. The 2% for D1 is a small-sample estimate.
30% selected. The feedthroughs support up to 30%.
